verses.transcription: antal qawiyyul lazii qawwaytanii biridan

verses.text: فِى السِّرِّ وَالْجَهْرِ يَاذَا الْأَمْرِ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: fis sirri wal jahri yaa zal amri yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْمَتِينُ الَّذِى قَدْ كُنْتَ لِى بِمُنًى
verses.transcription: antal matiinul lazii qad kunta lii bimunan
walaa tuwajjihu lil makruuha yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْوَلِىُّ الَّذِى لَآ أَبْتَغِى بَدَلًا
verses.transcription: antal waliyyul lazii laa abtaghii badalan
bihi wa lii kunta bit taamiini yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْحَمِيدُ الَّذِى وَجَّهْتَ لِى نِعَمًا
verses.transcription: antal hamiidul lazii wajjahta lii nihaman
bilaa ghuruurin wa ghayril makri yal laahu
yaa muhsiyal khalqi wal ash-yaa-i jumlatihaa
kafaytanii durra maa ahsayta yal laahu
yaa mubdii-al khalqi yaa man laa tuwajjihu lii
maa laa uhibbu radiitu hanka yal laahu

verses.text: مُعِيدُ أَحْمَدَ عَوْدٍ قُدْتَّ لِى كَرَمًا
verses.transcription: muhiidu ahmada hawdin qudtta lii karaman

verses.text: فِى كُلِّ شَهْرٍ وَيَوْمٍ فِيكَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: fii kulli shahrin wa yawmin fiika yal laahu

verses.text: مُحْيِى بِخَيْرِ حَيَاةٍ جُدْتَّ لِى أَبَدًا
verses.transcription: muhyii bikhayri hayaatin judtta lii abadan
falaka shukrii bisawfil humri yal laahu

verses.text: مُمِيتُ قَدْ سُقْتَ مَوْتِى لِلْعِدَى وَلَهُمْ
verses.transcription: mumiitu qad suqta mawtii lil hidaa wa lahum
makaarihii suqta fid daarayni yal laahu

verses.text: يَاحَىُّ حَمْدِى وَشُكْرِى مَعْ رِضَاىَ مَعًا
verses.transcription: yaa hayyu hamdii wa shukrii mah ridaaya mahan
minniya khuzduuna sukhtin minka yal laahu

verses.text: قَيُّومُ قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى مَاكُنْتُ أَطْلُبُهُ
verses.transcription: qayyuumu qad qudtta lii maa kuntu atlubuhu
bighayri kasbin ilal jannaati yal laahu

verses.text: أَوْ صَلْتَ لِى وَاجِدُ الْأَثْمَانَ دُونَ عَنَآ
verses.transcription: aw salta lii waajidul asmaana duuna hanaa

verses.text: لَّكَ الْوُجُودُ الَّذِى لِى بَانَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: lakal wujuudul lazii lii baana yal laahu
yaa maajiduj halniyad daarayni muhtaliyan
bighayri kibrin wa hujbin rabbi yal laahu
yaa waahiduj halniyad daarayni munfaridan
mahal munaa bihaziizi minka yal laahu

verses.text: لَكَ الْتِجَآءِى بِمَا لِى اخْتِيرَ يَاصَمَدِى
verses.transcription: lakal tijaa-ii bimaa likhtiira yaa samadii
bishran lijumlati man ahbabta yal laahu
ardayta yaa qaadirul makhzuula munzafihan
ilaa siwaanaa lakat tahmiidu yal laahu
razaqtanil hajji tayyan anta mukhtadirun
mahal jiwaari wa zawrin fiika yal laahu
antal muqaddimu qaddimnii hunaa wa ghadan
halaa kashiirin minal akh-yaari yal laahu
antal muwaakhkhiru azhabtal hidaa wa madaw
ilaa siwaanaa mahal  khiz-yaani yal laahu
wa innakal awwaluj halnii hunaa wa ghadan
fis saabiqiina bifadlin minka yal laahu
yaa aakhiruj halaniyad daarayni zaa rutabin
wa saqqi humrii ilal jannaati yal laahu
yaa zaahirur zuqniyal maamuula murtadiyan
hannii wa azhirniyal qur-aana yal laahu
yaa baatinur zuqniyal asraara zaa minanin
wajhal fu-aadiya zarfaz zikri yal laahu
hab lii bifadlika yaa waalii muwaasalatii
khayral baraayaa wa man waalayta yal laahu
wa innakal mutahaalii suq hidaaka mahan

verses.text: إِلَى سِوَى قَصْدِ ضُرِّى الدَّهْرَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: ilaa siwaa qasdi durrid dahra yal laahu
wassih wa mallik wa ahtiq duuna maqsadatin
wa lis tajib dahwatii ya barru yal laahu
halayya tubta mahawtaz zanba jumlatahu
tahharta kulliya yaa tawwaabu yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الَّذِى مِنْ عِدَى الْإِسْلَامِ مُنْتَقِمٌ
verses.transcription: antal lazii min hidal islaami muntaqimun

verses.text: وَلِى انْتَقَمْتَ بِمَا لِى اخْتَرتَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: wa lin taqamta bimaa likhtarta yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الْعَفُوُّ الَّذِى عَنِّى عَفَوْتَ بِلَآ
verses.transcription: antal hafuwwul lazii hannii hafawta bilaa
ibqaa-i haybin hadaytal kulla yal laahu
antar ra-uuful lazii haayantu ra-fatahu
walaa tuwajjihu lil ahdaa-a yal laahu

verses.text: يَامَالِكَ الْمُلْكِ لِى وَسَّعْتَ دُونَ جَوًى
verses.transcription: yaa maalikal mulki lii wa sahta duuna jawan
fil mulki wal malakuutid dahra yal laahu

verses.text: يَاذَا الْجَلَالِ وَذَا الْإِكْرَامِ هَبْ لِىَ مَا
verses.transcription: yaa zal jalaali wa zal ikraami hab liya maa

verses.text: لِى اخْتَرْتَ دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى مِنْكَ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: likhtarta dunyaa wa ukhraa minka yal laahu

verses.text: قُدْ لِىَ يَامُقْسِطُ الْمَطْلوبَ حَيْثُ أُرَى
verses.transcription: qud liya yaa muqsitul matluuba haysu uraa
khillan wa hibban mahar ridwaani yal laahu
yaa jaamihuj mah liyal aghraada murtajiyan

verses.text: عَنِّى بِكَوْبِكَ لِى فِى الْجَمْعِ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: hannii bikawnika lii fil  jamhi yal laahu
antal ghaniyyul lazii laa yantamii gharadun

verses.text: إِلَيْكَ هَبْ لِىَ مَآ أَحْتَاجُ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: ilayka hab liya maa ahtaaju yal laahu
aghnaytanii innakal mughnii bilaa sababin
fasarmadan liya kun bil fadli yal laahu
ahtaytanii innakal muhtii munal kuramaa
kafaytanii jumlatal ahdaa-i yal laahu
manahta yaa maanihul aswaa-a min qibalii
walaa tuwajjihu lii maasaa-a yal laahu

verses.text: مَنَعْتَ يَاضَارُ مِنِّى الضُّرَّ فِى أَبَدٍ
verses.transcription: manahta yaa daaru minnid durra fii abadin
walaa tuwajjihu lil idraara yal laahu

verses.text: لِى قُدْتَّ فِى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ نَّفْعَ ذِى كَرَمٍ
verses.transcription: lii qudtta fii kulli shay-in nafha zii karamin
yaa naafihan lizawil iimaani yal laahu
nawwarta yaa nuuru kullii saafiyan abadan
kafaytanii zulamal ash-yaa-i yal laahu

verses.text: قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى مِنْكَ يَاهَادِى هِدَايَةَ مَنْ
verses.transcription: qad qudtta lii minka yaa haadii hidaayata man
qad saahabul mustafal mukhtaari yal laahu
antal badiihul lazii baanat badaa-ihuhu
qudttal badaa-iha lil ajri yal laahu

verses.text: لِى صَفِّ عُمْرِىَ يَابَاقِى بِخَيْرِ رِضًى
verses.transcription: lii saffi humriya yaa baaqii bikhayri ridan
waltubqinii bikitaabil laahi yal laahu

verses.text: لِى قُدْتَّ جُمْلَةَ مَالِى اخْتَرْتَ مِنْ مِّنَنٍ
verses.transcription: lii qudtta jumlata maa likhtarta min minanin
wirasatan waarisal amwaati yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الرَّشِيدُ الَّذِى قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى رَشَدًا
verses.transcription: antar rashiidul lazii qad qudtta lii rashadan

verses.text: فِى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّعَ التَّبْشِيرِ يَاللَّهُ
verses.transcription: fii kulli shay-in mahat tabshiiri yal laahu

verses.text: أَنْتَ الصَّبُورُ الَّذِى وَجَّهْتَ لِى ثَمَنًا
verses.transcription: antas sabuurul lazii wajjahta lii samanan
wa qad zahabta bimaa aabaahu yal laahu
